name: com.aidancmays.inventory
description: Items as assets, an inventory of stacks sorted into bags by item category (limited or unlimited, storage, overflow), and souls-like equipment: several weapons per hand with one held, armour, rings, quick items and attuned spells, applying stat modifiers, tags and custom effects while in effect. Save snapshots, an item database and a debug panel included, and (with Netcode for GameObjects) a server-authoritative network sync.

samples.description: A character with one of every kind of item, to equip, cycle and use through the debug panel; a ring that adds a glow through a custom EquipEffect.
